title: Lazy Loading Traversals inside Business Transactions (Disconnected Domain Model)
pattern: Implicitly fetching child associations (lazy loading) while executing domain logic inside an active transactional boundary.
why_bad: Extreme performance degradation and transaction timeouts. It forces multiple round-trips to the database inside a critical write transaction, holding database connection locks open longer, causing transaction retries or deadlocks under concurrent load [248, 536].
detection: Chained property access on models (e.g., `entity.relation.sub_relation`) inside code marked as transactional.
counterexample: Explicitly fetching a flat projection/summary of needed values up-front using a targeted repository query.
fix: Query and load only the specific data (e.g., precomputed sum) needed for the business rule ahead of invoking the aggregate behavior.
